review: Fresh assembly/disassembly replay tiles the 42-byte range 0x4D38EA..0x4D3914 against the pinned image. Instruction order is VMOV R1→S0, VCVT.F32.U32, R1=1, register LSL into R2, UDIV R0/R2, VMOV+VCVT of quotient to S1, VDIV.F32 S0/S1, VCVT.U32.F32 with fractional bits 15, store through R3, return R0=0. The intermediate single-precision steps are retained; no integer-ratio simplification is claimed.
limitations: UDIV zero divisor depends on DIV_0_TRP; exceptional FP, subnormal, overflow, FP availability and FPSCR flags are not qualified by this map review.
Partial/unaccepted; no C implementation or coverage/gate promotion.
